name: confetti
title: Confetti
description: A short burst of square confetti on a canvas, triggered by a prop or a ref method.

css.content:
/* Confetti: a window-sized canvas above everything that never takes the pointer. */
.confetti { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; z-index: var(--z-toast); }

a11y: The canvas is aria-hidden and ignores the pointer, so it never blocks or announces anything.
Off under prefers-reduced-motion: no burst is drawn. Announce the event it celebrates in text as well.

props.name: burst
props.description: Fires a burst each time this number changes (not on mount). Or call `ref.current.fire()`.

props.name: origin
props.description: Where the burst starts, as 0 to 1 of the window. Default the centre.

props.name: colors
props.description: Fill colours. Default: the accent, foreground and muted tokens.
